user_reported_bug: Mark coordinates on map more accurately. Currently coordinate marked of client location is wrongly marked. Latitude and longitude details should be more précised to mark exact location on map.
summary: No relevant testing skill found. Focused UI/API verification showed coordinate storage, 6-decimal list display, edit persistence, dashboard LocationMap marker placement, and clear-history Z/+00:00 deletion work. However the requested Google Maps-style comma-separated paste into the Latitude field does not work in the real browser, so the fix is partial.

ui_bugs.issue: Pasting `28.6448723, 77.2166534` into the Latitude field does not auto-populate Latitude/Longitude. In Chromium the `type=number` input rejects/sanitizes the comma-separated value before the React `onChange` split logic receives it; tested paste left both fields blank.

integration_issues.issue: Code inspection shows `/site` renders Site Activation and does not import/render LocationMap. The marker was verified on `/dashboard` where `LocationMap` is actually used; if `/site` is the intended user-facing site map, that flow is still missing/misrouted.

action_items: Implement an explicit `onPaste` handler for Latitude fields that reads clipboard text and splits `lat, lng` before the browser number input sanitizes it; apply to both Create and Edit dialogs.
Clarify/fix the intended map route: if `/site` should show the site/instrument map, render LocationMap there or update navigation/spec to use `/dashboard`.
Retest create/edit paste split, precision round-trip, and map marker after the paste fix.
critical_code_review_comments: In `frontend/src/pages/Instruments.jsx`, the paste-split logic is attached to `onChange` on `Input type="number"`; this is not sufficient for comma-separated Google Maps coordinates because invalid comma text is not accepted as the number input value.
Create/Edit latitude and longitude inputs do have `type=number` and `step=0.000001`; list display uses `toFixed(6)` and backend models store floats without observed precision loss.
`frontend/src/pages/Site.jsx` is a Site Activation page, not a map page; `LocationMap` is rendered in `EnhancedDashboard.jsx`.
seed_data_creation: Seeded temporary instruments `QA_COORD_1784967337` and `QA_UI_COORD_MARKER`, plus four temporary readings for clear-history regression. All seeded registry rows/readings/categories were deleted after testing.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Use admin credentials from /app/memory/test_credentials.md. Backend API precision and clear-history passed. rca_of_the_issue: Repro: login as admin, open Instruments > Add Instrument, focus Latitude, paste `28.6448723, 77.2166534`. Expected Latitude=`28.6448723` and Longitude=`77.2166534`; actual both fields remained blank in real browser paste test. Root cause is likely relying on `onChange` for a `type=number` input, while comma-separated text is invalid for number inputs and is sanitized/rejected before React state sees it. Backend precision itself is OK: creating/listing/editing preserved 7/6-decimal values, and dashboard LocationMap popup showed `28.644872, 77.216653` at the marker. Clear-history deleted both `2026-07-24T18:34:17Z` and `2026-07-24T18:34:17+00:00` variants from both reading collections.
